reference_answer.response: The $6,000 scheduled limit applies only to the opal necklace. The gold ring remains subject to the base $1,500 jewelry-theft sublimit within the property limit. Extra inventory items that were not stolen, and the flyer saying one schedule covers all jewelry, do not change that. These are coverage limits, not approved payment amounts.

The base $1,500 per-occurrence jewelry theft sublimit remains for unscheduled jewelry.
